translated: Ready, set... ProSeka AfterTalk: With You Edition!
I'm Yui Ogura, the voice of Minori Hanasato from Momojan...
And I'm Rina Honnizumi, the voice of Shizuku Hinomori.
[CORNER: Fan Letter Corner] ProSeka AfterTalk is a program where we look back on the event while reading the letters you've sent in.
This time is the "With You" edition. Did everyone enjoy the story?
Oh, everyone in the comments is saying "Good evening."
Someone said, "The story made me cry."
I'm sure everyone has their own thoughts, and the two of us will be diving deep into them later.
There were some really emotionally stirring scenes.
It felt like a different world than usual, didn't it?
It was such a fresh story.
Let's dig deeper into it later.
